in_sanskrit.name: Sharun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of the Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shara', which means 'king' or 'leader'. The name also has connections to the sun god, Surya, as 'sharu' means 'ray of the sun'.
